data.title: Repeated words
data.statement:
When proofreading, some people have a hard time time seeing repeats, especially if they're broken up onto different lines. The brain just ignores them.

Print all of the repeated words found in a string, one on each line, to help find such words when editing text.

Words are separated by spaces or line breaks.
Ignore capitalization when comparing words.
Ignore non-alphabetical characters at the start or end of a word as long as they aren't between the repeated words.
Special characters between words counts as separating them, so those words should not be considered repeats.
When outputting a repeated group, print the first word exactly as it originally appears. {not yet implemented, will try after work.}
Print each repeated word on its own line, in the order found.

Example:
Input:
text Text text

Output:
text
Text

Reasoning:
the first pair of repeats is "text Text" so output "text".
The second pair of repeats is "Text text" so output "Text".

If there are no repeats, just write {{No repeats!}}.

testCases.title: Test 2
testCases.testIn: Sometimes double words are grammatically correct. What it is is super annoying, but we'll have to check them anyway.

testCases.title: Validator 2
testCases.testIn: I had had too big a meal \n People should know that that kind of thing could exist and not be wrong.

testCases.title: Test 3
testCases.testIn: No need to flag repeats when separated by punctuation. Punctuation separation is usually intentional. Even when you incorrectly do it ,it is probably just a typographical error and shouldn't be considered a repeat.

testCases.title: Test 4
testCases.testIn: Separating by a line might\nmight not be intentional, so it should be flagged. Even if it's \n it's meant to be a duplicate, it won't hurt to make sure.

testCases.title: Validator 4
testCases.testIn:
a
a hold
this toy	oy run*nrun jump!jump forever
forever

testCases.title: Test 5
testCases.testIn: Solutions should be able to handle apostrophes in the word and punctuation that doesn't separate words, !as as those shouldn't shouldn't'!? stop the word from being listed as a repeat. It should only focus on whitespace or line breaks.

data.constraints:
Input string will only contain ASCII characters.
Valid repeated words won't be separated by both punctuation and whitespace. e.g. "??a a??a" will not appear
Non-separating special characters won't contain alphabetical characters. e.g. "!@#JK#$%hi hi!!e!" will not appear
